title: Újpest's performance in opposition chance creation
subtitle: Újpest | Hungarian NB I 2026/2027

kpis.name: Opp. Box touches
kpis.description: Number of touches by the opponent inside the team's box per match.

kpis.name: Opp. Box to shot %
kpis.description: Percentage of possessions by the opponent inside the team's box that led to a shot per match.

kpis.name: Opp. np Shots
kpis.description: Number of non-penalty shots by the opponent per match.

kpis.name: Opp. High opportunity shots
kpis.description: Number of non-penalty shots by the opponent with expected goals higher than 0.15 per match.

kpis.name: Opp. np xG
kpis.description: Number of goals that the opponent should be expected to score statistically considering the quality of their chances, excluding penalties per match.

kpis.name: Opp. np Goals
kpis.description: Number of non-penalty goals by the opponent (including own-goals by the team) per match.

kpis.name: Opp. np xG per shot
kpis.description: Mean expected goals of the non-penalty shots of the opponent per match.
